# About the Author {.unnumbered}

**Moody Amakobe**

The author is an academic professional, applied researcher, and technologist working at the intersection of graduate AI education, decentralized systems research, and industry-informed pedagogy. He holds a Doctor of Computer Science from Colorado Technical University and brings more than a decade of senior engineering and architecture experience from organizations including T-Mobile, Accenture, Wipro, and Deloitte.

This book is published by Global Data Science Institute as an open educational resource.
